descriptionChirho: Free from guilt or blame, not deserving punishment; describes a person who has done no wrong and bears no liability for bloodshed or sin.
Released or free from a binding obligation, oath, or penalty; describes one who is no longer bound by a commitment or consequence.
Excused or exempted from a required duty or service, such as military conscription or civic obligation.
Physically or ritually clean and pure, free from contamination or moral defilement.
